_doc: Long-range (500 m cue) environment: the corridor runs diagonally from the launch at (0,0) to the intercept near (-160,-150), so the set covers x -600..100, y -360..90. Forest band north of the corridor (backdrop for south-side cameras), scatter south, bushes/tufts along the whole run for ground-rush speed cues at 20 m/s.
